items.text: tele for android is now available as a separate app, based on telegram android 13.0.2.
items.where: install tele alongside the official telegram app

items.text: automatic tele updates verify the downloaded apk checksum before opening the system installer.
release notes appear in a local tele chat; new settings are collected on the new in tele page.
tele server data is downloaded and matched locally; account information is not sent to the tele server.
